sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Protection & Equipment Setup
sop_modules.description: Deploy porch floor protection (drop cloths — critical for overhead drip fallout), cover/remove porch furniture, mask ceiling-mounted fixtures (ceiling fans, pendant lights), mask adjacent finished fascia/wall, set up ladders/scaffold and extension poles for overhead work.

tasks.name: Porch Floor Protection
tasks.description: Deploy canvas drop cloths and plastic sheeting over porch floor directly below ceiling work zone. CRITICAL for overhead work — gravity pulls all drips straight down onto porch floor. Brush/roll: drop cloths at key drip areas. Spray: full floor coverage.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage of porch floor below working area. Secure against foot traffic movement.

tasks.name: Porch Furniture Cover/Removal
tasks.description: Cover porch furniture, planters, and swings with plastic sheeting, or remove from porch area entirely. Removal is preferred when feasible. All items must be protected before any overhead work begins.

quality_notes.all: All furniture and items covered or removed. No exposed surfaces below ceiling work zone.

tasks.name: Porch Ceiling Fixture Masking
tasks.description: Mask porch ceiling-mounted fixtures — ceiling fans (remove blades if possible, or mask mounting plate and blade edges), pendant lights (bag fixture), recessed cans (tape ring and trim). Porch ceiling fans are common and require careful masking.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage of all ceiling-mounted fixtures. Fan blades removed or fully masked.

tasks.name: Fascia/Wall Edge Masking
tasks.description: Apply tape and masking film along fascia-ceiling and wall-ceiling junctions to protect finished surfaces from roller spatter. Only needed when adjacent surfaces are already painted.

quality_notes.all: Tape + masking film at junctions where adjacent surfaces are finished. Skip if unfinished.

tasks.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup for Overhead Work
tasks.description: Set up ladders or scaffold per access_type. Stage extension poles for overhead roller application, brushes, roller trays, and materials.

quality_notes.all: Stage extension poles (4-8 ft). Position ladder securely. Materials within reach at height.

tasks.name: Spray Equipment Setup for Overhead Work
tasks.description: Set up ladders or scaffold per access_type. Configure airless sprayer with 413-515 tip for overhead porch ceiling application. Lower pressure settings for overhead work to control overspray.

quality_notes.all: Verify tip size for overhead. Lower pressure than vertical. Stage spray shield for edge control.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Porch floor protection first → Furniture cover/removal → Fixture masking → Fascia/wall masking → Equipment setup last. ALL floor protection must be in place before any overhead work begins.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Surface Preparation
sop_modules.description: NC porch ceiling prep: low-pressure wash (NO power washing), sand for adhesion (substrate-specific grit), seal fiber cement cut edges, spot-prime tannin knots on wood, caulk panel joints, dust cleanup. All tasks are overhead.

tasks.name: Low-Pressure Wash Porch Ceiling
tasks.description: Clean porch ceiling with garden hose and soft bristle brush from ladder/scaffold. Remove construction dust, cobwebs, dirt. HIGH-PRESSURE POWER WASHING IS PROHIBITED (COMPAT-PRCH-006).

quality_notes.QT3: Full low-pressure wash. Allow 24 hr dry time.
quality_notes.QT4: Full wash with TSP/mildewcide solution. Allow 24-48 hr dry time.

tasks.name: Sand Wood Porch Ceiling for Adhesion
tasks.description: Sand bare wood porch ceiling (T&G, beadboard, plywood) with 80-120 grit for adhesion profile. Overhead sanding is slower and more fatiguing. Hand blocks for T&G/beadboard grooves, orbital sander for flat panels.

quality_notes.QT3: Full surface sand. Grooves hand-sanded.
quality_notes.QT4: Full surface with uniform scratch pattern. All grooves inspected.

tasks.name: Scuff Sand Fiber Cement Porch Ceiling
tasks.description: Light scuff sand factory-primed fiber cement panels with 150 grit for adhesion profile.

quality_notes.QT3: Light scuff. Creating tooth, not removing material.
quality_notes.QT4: Full surface scuff. Uniform scratch pattern.

tasks.name: End-Seal Fiber Cement Cut Edges
tasks.description: Brush end-cut sealer on ALL field-cut edges of fiber cement porch ceiling panels. Cut edges expose cellulose fibers (RISK-PRCH-004). Includes panel butt joints, miters, and field cuts.

quality_notes.all: EVERY cut edge sealed. Non-negotiable for warranty and performance.

tasks.name: Spot-Prime Tannin Knots on Wood Porch Ceiling
tasks.description: Brush alkyd or shellac-based stain blocker onto visible knots on tannin-rich porch ceiling boards (cedar, redwood) BEFORE full primer. Tannin bleed is especially visible on flat white and haint blue finishes.

quality_notes.QT3: All visible knots and sap streaks.
quality_notes.QT4: All knots spot-primed. Inspect under bright light.

tasks.name: Caulk Porch Ceiling Panel Joints and Junctions
tasks.description: Apply exterior paintable caulk to panel joints and ceiling-to-fascia/wall junctions. Overhead caulking is slower — gravity pulls caulk from bead. Caulk AFTER primer coat (COMPAT-PRCH-005).

quality_notes.QT3: All panel joints and junctions caulked. Smooth tool.
quality_notes.QT4: All joints with consistent bead. Precision tool overhead.

tasks.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust and debris from porch ceiling surface before coating. Tack cloth overhead.

quality_notes.all: All dust removed. Surface ready for primer.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Low-pressure wash → Dry time (24-48 hr) → Sand (substrate-specific) → Seal FC cut edges → Spot-prime wood knots → Caulk joints (AFTER prime) → Dust cleanup.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Prime Coat
sop_modules.description: Full field prime coat. Three substrate-driven primer paths: (1) acrylic primer for bare wood and factory-primed FC (SYS_EXT_PRCH_PRIMER_ACRYLIC), (2) alkali-resistant primer for bare FC (SYS_EXT_PRCH_PRIMER_ALKALI), (3) SKIP when SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD. Both spray and brush/roll always eligible (no vent constraint).

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply full prime coat by brush and roller with extension pole overhead. Brush for junctions and T&G/beadboard grooves, roller for open field. Primer product determined by substrate state.

quality_notes.QT3: Uniform coverage. Work primer into grooves. Maintain wet edge.
quality_notes.QT4: Perfect uniformity. Inspect under raking light at 3 ft.

tasks.name: Prime Coat — Spray Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply full prime coat by airless spray overhead. Always eligible on porch ceiling (no vent constraint). Lower pressure settings for overhead to control overspray.

quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build overhead.
quality_notes.QT4: Perfect uniformity. Inspect under raking light.

tasks.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer — Brush/Roll on Bare FC Porch Ceiling
tasks.description: Apply alkali-resistant primer (SYS_EXT_PRCH_PRIMER_ALKALI) by brush/roller on bare/damaged fiber cement porch ceiling. Required when factory primer is absent or damaged (pH 13.0).

quality_notes.all: Even coverage on porous bare FC overhead. Higher material consumption.

tasks.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer — Spray on Bare FC Porch Ceiling
tasks.description: Apply alkali-resistant primer by airless spray on bare fiber cement porch ceiling overhead.

quality_notes.all: Even coverage on porous substrate overhead.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Tannin spot-prime knots (wood, done in prep) → Full field prime. Method by application_method. Module SKIPPED when substrate_state = SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Finish Coat 1
sop_modules.description: First finish coat overhead. Brush/roll or spray (both always eligible). T&G/beadboard groove work requires brush even when spraying. Thin coats overhead to prevent sag.

tasks.name: Cut-In at Fascia/Wall/Column Junctions — Coat 1
tasks.description: Brush cut-in at fascia-ceiling, wall-ceiling, and column-ceiling junctions. Clean edge lines. Required for both brush/roll and spray methods.

quality_notes.QT3: Straight, consistent cut-in line.
quality_notes.QT4: Crisp, precise cut-in at 3 ft viewing standard.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat by roller with extension pole, brush for grooves and edges. Thin coats overhead. Back-brush immediately after rolling.

quality_notes.QT2: Even coverage. No drips or sags.
quality_notes.QT3: Uniform coverage. Consistent roller texture. Maintain wet edge.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform appearance. No visible roller marks at 6 ft.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Overhead Application
tasks.description: Apply first finish coat by airless spray overhead. Always eligible on porch ceiling. Tight fan pattern for controlled overhead application. On T&G/beadboard: brush-back grooves after spray pass.

quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 6 ft.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 3 ft.

tasks.name: T&G/Beadboard Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 1
tasks.description: Brush paint into T&G/beadboard groove joints after spray pass while wet. Spray alone does not penetrate groove channels. Two-person operation: sprayer leads, brusher follows within 30-60 sec.

quality_notes.all: Work paint into every groove joint while wet. Follow sprayer within 30-60 seconds.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in at junctions → Spray or roll field → Groove brush-back (spray + T&G/beadboard only). QT2 may stop here (single coat).

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Interstage Inspection
sop_modules.description: Intercoat inspection and remediation. QT4: light sand between coats (220 grit), dust removal. QT3: inspect and touch-up only. QT2: skipped (single coat).

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection — Overhead
tasks.description: Visual inspection of first finish coat from ladder/scaffold. Check for runs, sags, holidays, drip marks. Overhead inspection needs headlamp/portable light.

quality_notes.QT3: Quick scan for obvious defects.
quality_notes.QT4: Systematic inspection with raking light. Mark all defects.

tasks.name: Intercoat Light Sand — QT4 Only
tasks.description: 220 grit light scuff between finish coats overhead. QT4 only.

quality_notes.QT4: Light uniform scuff. Remove nibs, drip marks. No deep scratches.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during interstage inspection overhead.

quality_notes.QT3: Fix obvious defects.
quality_notes.QT4: Fix all found defects. Blend repairs.

tasks.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
tasks.description: Tack cloth dust removal after intercoat sanding overhead. QT4 only.

quality_notes.QT4: All sanding dust removed. Surface clean for second coat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Sand (QT4 only) → Touch-up → Dust removal (QT4 only). Allow recoat time per product TDS.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Finish Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Second finish coat overhead. Same method as first. QT3 and QT4 only (QT2 is single coat).

tasks.name: Cut-In at Fascia/Wall/Column Junctions — Coat 2
tasks.description: Brush cut-in at junctions for second coat. Final appearance coat.

quality_notes.QT3: Straight, consistent cut-in. Final coat.
quality_notes.QT4: Crisp, precise cut-in at 3 ft viewing standard.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Overhead
tasks.description: Second finish coat by roller/brush overhead. Final appearance coat.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. Consistent appearance. Maintain wet edge.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform appearance. No visible roller marks at 3 ft.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Overhead
tasks.description: Second finish coat by airless spray overhead. Final appearance coat.

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. Consistent appearance.
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform mil build. No visible pattern at 3 ft.

tasks.name: T&G/Beadboard Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 2
tasks.description: Brush paint into groove joints after spray pass for second coat. Final coat — all grooves must have full coverage.

quality_notes.all: All grooves fully coated. Follow sprayer within 30-60 sec. Final coat.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Cut-in → Spray or roll field → Groove brush-back (spray + T&G/beadboard only). Final appearance coat.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Final Inspection
sop_modules.description: Final walkthrough inspection and overhead touch-up.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection — Overhead
tasks.description: Final walkthrough of completed porch ceiling from ground level and ladder. Check for drip marks, sags, holidays, groove coverage.

quality_notes.QT2: No obvious misses or drip marks from ground.
quality_notes.QT3: No defects visible at 6-10 ft. Grooves covered.
quality_notes.QT4: No defects at 6 ft. Coverage uniform. Edge lines crisp.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up — Overhead
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final inspection.

quality_notes.QT2: Fix obvious misses and drip marks.
quality_notes.QT3: Fix all noted defects.
quality_notes.QT4: All defects repaired. Touch-ups blended seamlessly.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Cleanup & Protection Teardown
sop_modules.description: Remove all protection materials, clean equipment, restore porch furniture to original positions.

tasks.name: Protection Material Removal
tasks.description: Remove porch floor drop cloths, furniture covers, fascia/wall masking tape/film, fixture masks. Restore porch furniture to original positions.

quality_notes.QT3: All removed. No tape residue. Furniture in original positions.
quality_notes.QT4: All removed. Inspect for tape residue. Furniture restored. Check porch floor for paint transfer.

tasks.name: Clean Equipment
tasks.description: Clean rollers, brushes, extension poles. Flush airless sprayer if used.

quality_notes.QT3: Full flush. Tips/filters cleaned.
quality_notes.QT4: Full flush cycle. Equipment ready for next use.

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect debris — sandpaper, caulk tubes, tape, paint cans, roller covers. Final porch walkthrough.

quality_notes.QT3: Porch restored to pre-work condition.
quality_notes.QT4: Porch restored. Walkthrough with customer.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: Standard NC: 1 prime + 2 finish coats at QT3/QT4 on bare or factory-primed substrates.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats Only (Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Skip prime, 2 finish coats for SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD at QT3/QT4.

round_configurations.name: 1 Finish Coat Only (Economy, Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Economy QT2 single finish coat on field-primed surface.

assumptions: All base rates include overhead work penalty (~25-35% reduction from vertical baselines). Do NOT apply FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD as a stacking modifier.
Spray application is ALWAYS eligible on porch ceiling (no vent type constraint, unlike soffit).
T&G and beadboard both have 1.20x joint complexity modifier (FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS).
Caulk AFTER primer coat per COMPAT-PRCH-005.
No vinyl substrate — no bonding primer or solar-reflective finish system.
